jobs.description:
Overview
 The Strategic Account Technology Strategist (S-ATS) is Microsoft's experienced technology advisor for a strategic Insurance Financial Services customer. Acting as a virtual CTO, the S-ATS owns executive technology relationships, shapes the customer's long-term technology strategy, and aligns Microsoft AI, Cloud, Security, Data, and Modern Workplace capabilities to business outcomes.The S-ATS works closely with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and business executives to drive digital transformation, modernisation, AI adoption, and innovation.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
 Customer & Industry Leadership

• Develop deep understanding of the customer's business strategy, industry trends, regulatory environment, and market ecosystem.

• Act as a trusted advisor to executive technology stakeholders.

• Provide thought leadership on AI, cloud transformation, cyber security, data platforms, digital operations, and future-state architectures.

• Bring industry-specific insights and use cases relevant to Financial Services.
 Technology Strategy

• Define and drive the customer's technology roadmap.

• Translate business priorities into technology outcomes.

• Lead technical envisioning and architecture discussions.

• Help customers develop secure AI and cloud adoption strategies.

• Influence long-term platform and architecture decisions.
 Executive Engagement

• Own relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs and technology leadership teams.

• Facilitate executive workshops and strategic planning sessions.

• Connect business value with technology investments.

• Drive executive alignment on transformation initiatives.
 Orchestration & Sales Leadership

• Lead virtual teams across Microsoft, partners, engineering, consulting and customer success organisations.

• Orchestrate specialists, architects, security experts, services teams and partners around customer outcomes.

• Support strategic opportunities and growth initiatives.

• Accelerate Azure, AI, Security, Data and Copilot adoption.
 Business Impact

• Drive measurable business outcomes for customers.

• Support Azure consumption growth and AI transformation.

• Develop customer investment strategies and roadmaps.

• Ensure value realisation across strategic programmes.

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or related field AND extensive experience in technology consulting, enterprise architecture, technical sales, or digital transformation.

• Solid understanding of cloud, AI, security, data and application platforms.

• Proven success working with top business and technology executives.

• Deep Financial Services industry experience, specifically in Insurance

• English language
 Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading large-scale cloud transformations.

• AI and Data platform strategy experience.

• Enterprise architecture and operating model transformation.

• Experience working directly with C-level stakeholders.

• Executive communication and influencing skills.

• German language

Lo Strategista Strategic Account Technology (S-ATS) è il consulente tecnologico esperto di Microsoft per un cliente strategico dei Servizi Finanziari di Assicurazione. Agendo come CTO virtuale, il S-ATS possiede relazioni tecnologiche esecutive, modella la strategia tecnologica a lungo termine del cliente, e allinea le capacità di Microsoft AI, Cloud, Security, Data e Modern Workplace ai risultati aziendali. La S-ATS lavora a stretto contatto con CIO, CTO, CDO, CISO, architetti d'impresa e dirigenti aziendali per guidare la trasformazione digitale, la modernizzazione, l'adozione di AI e l'innovazione.
La missione di Microsoft è di consentire a ogni persona e ogni organizzazione del pianeta di ottenere di più. Come dipendenti ci uniamo a una mentalità di crescita, innovare per potenziare gli altri, e collaborare per realizzare i nostri obiettivi condivisi. Ogni giorno costruiamo sui nostri valori di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità per creare una cultura di inclusione dove tutti possono prosperare al lavoro e oltre.

• Portare informazioni specifiche del settore e casi di utilizzo rilevanti per i servizi finanziari.

• Tradurre le priorità aziendali nei risultati della tecnologia.

• Condurre le discussioni tecniche e l'architettura.

• Aiuta i clienti a sviluppare strategie di adozione sicure di AI e cloud.

• Influenza su piattaforme a lungo termine e decisioni di architettura.
Impegno esecutivo

• Rapporti con CIO, CTO, CDO, CISO e team di leadership tecnologica.

• Facilitare workshop esecutivi e sessioni di pianificazione strategica.

• Collegare il valore aziendale con gli investimenti tecnologici.

• Guidare l'allineamento esecutivo sulle iniziative di trasformazione.
Orchestrazione e leadership di vendita

• Leader team virtuali in Microsoft, partner, ingegneria, consulenza e organizzazioni di successo del cliente.

• Specialisti, architetti, esperti di sicurezza, team di servizi e partner intorno ai risultati del cliente.

• Sostenere opportunità strategiche e iniziative di crescita.

• Accelerare l'adozione di Azure, AI, Sicurezza, Dati e Copilota.
Impatto commerciale

• Guidare risultati aziendali misurabili per i clienti.

• Sostenere la crescita dei consumi Azure e la trasformazione AI.

• Sviluppare strategie di investimento dei clienti e roadmap.

• Assicurare la realizzazione del valore attraverso i programmi strategici.

Qualifiche
Qualificazioni richieste

• Corso di laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Tecnologia dell'informazione, Business, o relativo campo E vasta esperienza nella consulenza tecnologica, architettura aziendale, vendite tecniche o trasformazione digitale.

• Solida comprensione delle piattaforme cloud, AI, sicurezza, dati e applicazioni.

• E' stato un successo lavorare con i migliori dirigenti aziendali e tecnologici.

• Esperienza nel settore dei Servizi Finanziari Profonda, in particolare nell'assicurazione

• Lingua inglese
Qualificazioni predestinate

• Scopri le principali trasformazioni cloud su larga scala.

• Esperienza di strategia della piattaforma AI e Data.

• Architettura aziendale e trasformazione del modello operativo.

• Esperienza di lavoro direttamente con gli stakeholder di livello C.

• Comunicazione esecutiva e competenze influenti.

jobs.description:
Overview
 We are seeking a Data Research Engineer to join our AI team , where we are building the next generation of foundation models across different modalities: text, image, video, audio. If you are passionate about exploring, designing, and building high-quality datasets to drive frontier AI models, this role is for you.

At Microsoft AI, data is at the heart of innovation—and in this role, you will collaborate closely with other colleagues to curate, analyse, and evaluate diverse data sources critical to model development. You’ll lead efforts in developing novel data collection strategies, improving dataset quality, understanding data-driven model behaviours, and aligning datasets with ethical and societal values.

This is a cross-disciplinary, high-impact role ideal for engineers who want to push the boundaries of what AI can learn from data.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Create high-quality datasets for training and evaluation; run experiments on new datasets (data ablations) to assess their impact and determine the most effective data

• Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines for data ingestion, pre-processing, filtering, and annotation

• Analyse real-world multimodal datasets to assess quality, diversity, relevance, and identify areas for improvement

• Build tools and workflows for dataset auditing, visualization, and versioning

• Collaborate with Safety, Ethics, and Governance teams to ensure datasets meet standards for quality, privacy, and responsible AI practices

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree in AI, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Proficiency in Python.

• Experience with distributed data-processing frameworks such as Spark, Ray and workflow-orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• Experience with processing datasets at many petabyte scale and with trillion rows.

• Experience building datasets for training foundation models, including language or multimodal models.

• Strong experience in data analysis, data engineering, or both.

• Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and effectively to research, engineering, and product teams.

• Experience evaluating dataset quality and measuring the impact of data through controlled model-training experiments.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

• Experience working with large-scale, real-world datasets that are unstructured or semi-structured

• Experience with multimodal data, such as image, video, or audio data.

Stiamo cercando Data Research Engineers di unirsi al nostro team Multimodal, dove stiamo costruendo la prossima generazione di modelli di fondazione attraverso la visione, la lingua, l'audio e oltre. Se siete appassionati di esplorare, progettare e costruire set di dati di alta qualità per guidare i modelli AI di frontiera, questo ruolo è per voi.

In Microsoft AI, i dati sono al centro dell'innovazione, e in questo ruolo, collaborerai a stretto contatto con scienziati, ingegneri e annotatori per curare, analizzare e valutare diverse fonti di dati multimodali critiche allo sviluppo del modello. Condurrai gli sforzi nello sviluppo di nuove strategie di raccolta dei dati, nel miglioramento della qualità dei dataset, nella comprensione dei comportamenti dei modelli basati sui dati e nell'allineamento dei dataset con valori etici e sociali.

Questo è un ruolo interdisciplinare, ad alto impatto ideale per gli ingegneri che vogliono spingere i confini di ciò che l'IA può imparare dai dati, soprattutto in contesti multimodali.

La missione di Microsoft è di consentire a ogni persona e ogni organizzazione del pianeta di ottenere di più. Come dipendenti ci uniamo a una mentalità di crescita, innovare per potenziare gli altri, e collaborare per realizzare i nostri obiettivi condivisi. Ogni giorno costruiamo sui nostri valori di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità per creare una cultura di inclusione dove tutti possono prosperare al lavoro e oltre.

responsabilità

Creare set di dati di alta qualità per la formazione e la valutazione; eseguire esperimenti su nuovi set di dati (ablazioni di dati) per valutare il loro impatto e determinare i dati più efficaci

Sviluppare e mantenere le pipeline di dati scalabili per ingestione multimodale, pre-elaborazione, filtraggio e annotazione

Analizzare i dataset multimodali del mondo reale per valutare la qualità, la diversità, la rilevanza e identificare le aree per il miglioramento

Costruisci strumenti e flussi di lavoro leggeri per l'auditing dataset, la visualizzazione e la versione

Overview
We are seeking a Data Research Engineer to join our AI team , where we are building the next generation of foundation models across different modalities: text, image, video, audio. If you are passionate about exploring, designing, and building high-quality datasets to drive frontier AI models, this role is for you.

At Microsoft AI, data is at the heart of innovation—and in this role, you will collaborate closely with other colleagues to curate, analyse, and evaluate diverse data sources critical to model development. You’ll lead efforts in developing novel data collection strategies, improving dataset quality, understanding data-driven model behaviours, and aligning datasets with ethical and societal values.

This is a cross-disciplinary, high-impact role ideal for engineers who want to push the boundaries of what AI can learn from data.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Create high-quality datasets for training and evaluation; run experiments on new datasets (data ablations) to assess their impact and determine the most effective data

• Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines for data ingestion, pre-processing, filtering, and annotation

• Analyse real-world multimodal datasets to assess quality, diversity, relevance, and identify areas for improvement

• Build tools and workflows for dataset auditing, visualization, and versioning

• Collaborate with Safety, Ethics, and Governance teams to ensure datasets meet standards for quality, privacy, and responsible AI practices

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree in AI, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Proficiency in Python.

• Experience with distributed data-processing frameworks such as Spark, Ray and workflow-orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• Experience with processing datasets at many petabyte scale and with trillion rows.

• Experience building datasets for training foundation models, including language or multimodal models.

• Strong experience in data analysis, data engineering, or both.

• Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and effectively to research, engineering, and product teams.

• Experience evaluating dataset quality and measuring the impact of data through controlled model-training experiments.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

• Experience working with large-scale, real-world datasets that are unstructured or semi-structured

• Experience with multimodal data, such as image, video, or audio data.

Aperçu général

Nous cherchons des ingénieurs de recherche de données pour rejoindre notre équipe multimodale , où nous construisons la prochaine génération de modèles de fondation à travers la vision, la langue, l'audio et au-delà. Si vous êtes passionné par l'exploration, la conception et la construction d'ensembles de données de haute qualité pour conduire des modèles d'IA frontaliers, ce rôle est pour vous.

Overview
 Are you looking to make a broad impact across a dynamic organization, work closely with executives, and grow toward a future Chief of Staff role? If so, this opportunity could be the perfect fit.

As Account Team Unit (ATU) Business Manager, you will partner with the Switzerland three ATU leads to optimize sales team processes and capabilities across Enterprise Commercial, Financial Services, and Public Sector. You will play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence, strategic alignment, and customer engagement readiness.
 We are looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented team player with excellen communication skills, a passion for execution and process improvement, and a desire to help the Switzerland organization thrive.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Business Operations, Planning & Change Management
 Partners with the Swiss Office Team and ATU stakeholders to drive planning processes, ensuring alignment with corporate rhythms and integration across the broader organization.
 Partners with ATU leaders on strategic business planning, providing insights, recommendations, and decision-support to drive business outcomes and organizational priorities.
 Synthesizes business performance data, market trends, and organizational insights into executive-level recommendations and action plans.
 Manages the Rhythm of Business (ROB) motions, including fiscal year planning, business reviews, customer/partner engagement, events (internal/external), and strategic initiatives in close collaboration with Sales Excellence, Finance, and other key stakeholders.
 Collaborates with EMEA and global teams to land programs and initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment and execution excellence.
 Identifies and advocates for performance improvement actions, working closely with SE&O on resource planning, blueprint optimization, and headcount management.
 Supports the landing of the organization’s transformational goals across HR, Customer Experience, Finance, and Business Planning pillars.
 Promotes ATU identity and culture through the orchestration of town halls, leadership workshops, and team offsites, fostering alignment, engagement, and a shared sense of purpose across the Switzerland ATU.
 Builds partnerships across Sales Excellence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, Communications, and EMEA business management teams to drive execution of key priorities and organizational objectives
 Drives continuous improvement by capturing and acting on team feedback through platforms such as Employee Signals, Employee Listening, and other feedback loops, ensuring that insights are translated into meaningful actions that enhance team effectiveness and engagement.

• Executive Leader and Team Communications
 Executes ATU internal communications strategy and programs. Reviews, supports, and helps to refine work of team members with relevant content (e.g., customer/partner decks, event decks, results summaries, team SharePoint).

• Customer & Executive Engagement Readiness
 Partners with account teams and executives to drive high-impact customer engagements through strategic briefing preparation, messaging alignment, executive readiness, and post-engagement follow-through.
 Supports the development of customer engagement frameworks that drive consistency, impact, and measurable outcomes.

• Maximizing / Extending the ATU Leadership Team
 Acts as a trusted advisor to the Switzerland ATU leadership team, ensuring alignment on priorities, decision making, executive follow-through, and organizational effectiveness.
 Drives leadership team cadence, agenda management, action tracking, and cross-functional accountability.

• Special Projects, Programs & Initiatives
 Leads or contributes to cross-team strategic projects that address evolving business needs.
 Executes hands-on work across multiple disciplines, including strategic efforts that require coordination, analysis, and stakeholder management.
 Drives initiatives that enhance organizational effectiveness, employee experience, and customer satisfaction.

• AI Transformation
 Identifies opportunities to improve team productivity and effectiveness through automation, AI-enabled solutions, and process innovation.

Qualifications
 Required/Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Management, Computer Science) AND experience in business management experience in field/sales environments and working on rhythm-of-business activities including business operations, business management, finance, or other similar environments

• OR equivalent experience

• Experience in orchestrating executive sponsor engagement strategies, including briefing preparation, stakeholder alignment, and follow-up accountability to elevate customer impact.

• Track record of leading cross-functional programs and special projects that drive business transformation, customer satisfaction, and internal process optimization.
 Preferred Qualifications:

• German (written and verbal) is strongly preferred, to effectively engage with regional stakeholders and support communication across German-speaking markets. French and Italian would be an additional asset.

In qualità di Account Team Unit (ATU) Business Manager, sarete partner con la Svizzera tre ATU porta ad ottimizzare i processi e le capacità del team di vendita attraverso Enterprise Commercial, Financial Services e Public Sector. Si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel guidare l'eccellenza operativa, l'allineamento strategico e la disponibilità di impegno del cliente.
 Siamo alla ricerca di un team player ad alta energia, orientato al dettaglio con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, una passione per l'esecuzione e il miglioramento dei processi, e il desiderio di aiutare l'organizzazione svizzera a prosperare.
 La missione di Microsoft è di consentire a ogni persona e ogni organizzazione del pianeta di ottenere di più. Come dipendenti ci uniamo con una mentalità di crescita, innovare per potenziare gli altri, e collaborare per realizzare i nostri obiettivi condivisi. Ogni giorno costruiamo sui nostri valori di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità per creare una cultura di inclusione dove tutti possono prosperare al lavoro e oltre.

responsabilità

 Partner del team di uffici e degli stakeholder ATU per guidare i processi di pianificazione, garantendo l'allineamento con i ritmi aziendali e l'integrazione in tutta l'organizzazione più ampia.
 Partner con i leader ATU sulla pianificazione strategica delle imprese, fornendo informazioni, raccomandazioni e supporto decisionale per guidare i risultati aziendali e le priorità organizzative.
 sintetizza i dati delle prestazioni aziendali, le tendenze del mercato e le intuizioni organizzative su raccomandazioni e piani di azione a livello esecutivo.
 Gestisce i movimenti Rhythm of Business (ROB), tra cui la pianificazione dell'anno fiscale, le recensioni aziendali, il coinvolgimento del cliente/partner, gli eventi (internal/esterno), e le iniziative strategiche in stretta collaborazione con Sales Excellence, Finance e altri stakeholder chiave.
 Collabora con EMEA e team globali per programmi e iniziative di terra, garantendo l'allineamento interfunzionale e l'eccellenza dell'esecuzione.
 Identificare e sostenere le azioni di miglioramento delle prestazioni, lavorando a stretto contatto con SE&O sulla pianificazione delle risorse, l'ottimizzazione dei progetti e la gestione dei conti.
 Supporta lo sbarco degli obiettivi di trasformazione dell'organizzazione attraverso i pilastri HR, Customer Experience, Finance e Business Planning.
 Promuove l'identità e la cultura dell'ATU attraverso l'orchestrazione di sale comunali, laboratori di leadership e dipartimenti di team, promuovendo l'allineamento, l'impegno e un senso comune di scopo in tutta la Svizzera ATU.
 Costruire partnership tra Eccellenza Vendite, Finanza, HR, Marketing, Successo dei Clienti, Comunicazioni e team di gestione aziendale EMEA per guidare l'esecuzione di priorità chiave e obiettivi organizzativi
 Guida il miglioramento continuo catturando e agendo sul feedback del team attraverso piattaforme come Segnali dei dipendenti, Ascoltare i dipendenti e altri loop di feedback, assicurando che gli insight siano tradotti in azioni significative che migliorano l'efficacia e l'impegno del team.

Übersicht
 Möchten Sie eine breite Wirkung in einer dynamischen Organisation erzielen, eng mit Führungskräften zusammenarbeiten und auf eine zukünftige Rolle des Stabschefs zusteuern? Wenn ja, könnte diese Gelegenheit die perfekte Lösung sein.

Als Business Manager der Account Team Unit (ATU) arbeiten Sie mit drei ATU-Leitern der Schweiz zusammen, um die Prozesse und Fähigkeiten des Vertriebsteams in den Bereichen Enterprise Commercial, Financial Services und Public Sector zu optimieren. Sie werden eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Förderung von operativer Exzellenz, strategischer Ausrichtung und Kundenbindungsbereitschaft spielen.
 Wir suchen einen energiegeladenen, detailorientierten Teamplayer mit hervorragenden Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, einer Leidenschaft für die Ausführung und Prozessverbesserung und dem Wunsch, der Schweizer Organisation zum Erfolg zu verhelfen.
 Microsofts Mission ist es, jede Person und jedes Unternehmen auf dem Planeten zu befähigen, mehr zu erreichen. Als Mitarbeiter kommen wir mit einer Wachstumsmentalität zusammen, innovieren, um andere zu stärken, und arbeiten zusammen, um unsere gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen. Jeden Tag bauen wir auf unseren Werten Respekt, Integrität und Rechenschaftspflicht auf, um eine Kultur der Inklusion zu schaffen, in der jeder bei der Arbeit und darüber hinaus gedeihen kann.

Zuständigkeiten

• Business Operations, Planung & Change Management
 Zusammenarbeit mit dem Swiss Office Team und den ATU-Stakeholdern, um die Planungsprozesse voranzutreiben und die Abstimmung mit den Unternehmensrhythmen und die Integration in der gesamten Organisation sicherzustellen.
 Partner mit ATU-Führungskräften bei der strategischen Geschäftsplanung und bietet Einblicke, Empfehlungen und Entscheidungshilfe, um Geschäftsergebnisse und organisatorische Prioritäten zu fördern.
 Synthetisiert Geschäftsleistungsdaten, Markttrends und organisatorische Einblicke in Empfehlungen und Aktionspläne auf Führungsebene.
 Verwaltet die Rhythm of Business (ROB) -Bewegungen, einschließlich der Geschäftsjahresplanung, Geschäftsbewertungen, Kunden- / Partnerbindung, Veranstaltungen (intern / extern) und strategischen Initiativen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Sales Excellence, Finance und anderen wichtigen Stakeholdern.
 Arbeitet mit EMEA und globalen Teams zusammen, um Programme und Initiativen zu landen und so eine funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung und Ausführungsqualität zu gewährleisten.
 Identifiziert und befürwortet Performance-Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und arbeitet eng mit SE & O in den Bereichen Ressourcenplanung, Blueprint-Optimierung und Headcount-Management zusammen.
 Unterstützt die Landung der Transformationsziele des Unternehmens in den Säulen HR, Customer Experience, Finance und Business Planning.
 Fördert die Identität und Kultur der ATU durch die Orchestrierung von Rathäusern, Führungsworkshops und Teamoffsites und fördert die Ausrichtung, das Engagement und ein gemeinsames Zielbewusstsein in der gesamten Schweizer ATU.
 Aufbau von Partnerschaften zwischen Sales Excellence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, Communications und EMEA Business Management Teams, um die Umsetzung wichtiger Prioritäten und organisatorischer Ziele voranzutreiben
 Steigende Verbesserung durch Erfassung und Handeln auf Team-Feedback durch Plattformen wie Mitarbeiter-Signale, Mitarbeiter-Hören und andere Feedback-Schleifen, um sicherzustellen, dass Erkenntnisse in sinnvolle Aktionen umgesetzt werden, die die Effektivität und das Engagement des Teams verbessern.

• Executive Leader und Teamkommunikation
 Führt interne ATU-Kommunikationsstrategien und -programme aus. Überprüfen, unterstützen und verfeinern Sie die Arbeit von Teammitgliedern mit relevanten Inhalten (z. B. Kunden- / Partnerdecks, Ereignisdecks, Ergebniszusammenfassungen, Team SharePoint).

• Customer & Executive Engagement Bereitschaft
 Partnerschaften mit Account-Teams und Führungskräften, um Kundenbindungen mit hoher Wirkung durch strategische Briefing-Vorbereitung, Messaging-Ausrichtung, Führungsbereitschaft und Follow-Through nach dem Engagement zu fördern.
 Unterstützt die Entwicklung von Customer Engagement Frameworks, die Konsistenz, Auswirkungen und messbare Ergebnisse fördern.

• Maximierung / Erweiterung des ATU Leadership Teams
 Funktioniert als vertrauenswürdiger Berater des Schweizer ATU-Führungsteams und gewährleistet die Ausrichtung auf Prioritäten, Entscheidungsfindung, Follow-Through und organisatorische Effektivität.
 Betreibt die Kadenz des Führungsteams, das Agenda-Management, das Action-Tracking und die funktionsübergreifende Rechenschaftspflicht.

 Leitet oder trägt zu teamübergreifenden strategischen Projekten bei, die auf sich ändernde Geschäftsanforderungen eingehen.
 Führt praktische Arbeit in mehreren Disziplinen durch, einschließlich strategischer Bemühungen, die Koordination, Analyse und Stakeholder-Management erfordern.
 Fördert Initiativen, die die organisatorische Effektivität, die Mitarbeitererfahrung und die Kundenzufriedenheit verbessern.

 Identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Teamproduktivität und -effektivität durch Automatisierung, KI-fähige Lösungen und Prozessinnovation.

 Vous cherchez à avoir un large impact dans une organisation dynamique, à travailler en étroite collaboration avec les cadres et à devenir un futur chef de cabinet? Si oui, cette opportunité pourrait être parfaite.

En tant que responsable d'entreprise de l'unité de compte (ATU), vous vous associerez à la Suisse trois ATU mènent à optimiser les processus et les capacités de l'équipe de vente dans les secteurs commercial, financier et public. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'excellence opérationnelle, l'alignement stratégique et l'engagement des clients.
 Nous sommes à la recherche d'un team player de haute énergie, axé sur les détails, doté d'excellentes compétences en communication, d'une passion pour l'exécution et l'amélioration des processus, et d'un désir d'aider l'organisation suisse à prospérer.
 La mission de Microsoft est d'habiliter chaque personne et chaque organisation de la planète à réaliser davantage. En tant qu'employés, nous nous associons à une mentalité de croissance, innovons pour responsabiliser les autres et collaborons pour réaliser nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d'intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture d'inclusion où chacun peut prospérer au travail et au-delà.

Responsabilités

• Opérations, planification et gestion du changement
 Partenaires avec l'équipe du Bureau suisse et les parties prenantes de l'ATU pour diriger les processus de planification, assurer l'alignement avec les rythmes d'entreprise et l'intégration dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
 Partenaires avec les dirigeants de l'ATU dans la planification stratégique des activités, fournissant des idées, des recommandations et un soutien à la décision pour stimuler les résultats opérationnels et les priorités organisationnelles.
 Synthèse des données sur le rendement des entreprises, des tendances du marché et des renseignements organisationnels sur les recommandations et les plans d'action des cadres supérieurs.
 Gère les motions du Rhythme des affaires (ROB), y compris la planification de l'exercice financier, les avis d'affaires, l'engagement des clients et des partenaires, les événements (internes et externes) et les initiatives stratégiques en étroite collaboration avec Excellence des ventes, Finances et d'autres intervenants clés.
 Collabore avec l'EMEA et des équipes mondiales à des programmes et initiatives fonciers, assurant ainsi l'harmonisation et l'excellence d'exécution interfonctionnelles.
 Identifier et préconiser des mesures d'amélioration du rendement, travailler en étroite collaboration avec SE&O sur la planification des ressources, l'optimisation des plans et la gestion des effectifs.
 Appuie l'établissement des objectifs transformationnels de l'organisation dans les domaines des RH, de l'expérience client, des finances et de la planification opérationnelle.
 Promouvoir l'identité et la culture de l'ATU par l'orchestration de mairies, d'ateliers de leadership et d'équipes hors site, en favorisant l'alignement, l'engagement et un sens commun de l'objectif dans toute la Suisse ATU.
 Bâtir des partenariats entre les équipes de gestion des activités d'excellence commerciale, de finances, de RH, de marketing, de réussite client, de communications et d'EMEA afin de stimuler l'exécution des priorités clés et des objectifs organisationnels
 Incite l'amélioration continue en captant et en agissant sur la rétroaction de l'équipe au moyen de plateformes telles que les signaux des employés, l'écoute des employés et d'autres boucles de rétroaction, en veillant à ce que les renseignements soient traduits en mesures significatives qui améliorent l'efficacité et l'engagement de l'équipe.

• Chef exécutif et communications d'équipe
 Exécute la stratégie et les programmes de communication interne de l'ATU. Examens, soutiens et aide à affiner le travail des membres de l'équipe avec du contenu pertinent (p. ex., decks clients/partenaires, decks d'événements, résumés des résultats, team SharePoint).

• Capacité d'engagement des clients et des cadres supérieurs
 Partenaires avec les équipes de comptabilité et les cadres supérieurs afin d'encourager les engagements des clients à grande incidence par la préparation d'exposés stratégiques, l'alignement des messages, la préparation des cadres supérieurs et le suivi après l'engagement.
 Appuyer l'élaboration de cadres d'engagement des clients qui favorisent l'uniformité, l'impact et les résultats mesurables.

• Maximiser / étendre l'équipe de leadership de l'ATU
 Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès de l'équipe de direction de l'ATU en Suisse, en assurant l'alignement sur les priorités, la prise de décision, le suivi des cadres et l'efficacité organisationnelle.
 Dirige la cadence de l'équipe de leadership, la gestion des programmes, le suivi des mesures et la responsabilisation interfonctionnelle.

• Projets, programmes et initiatives spéciaux
 Diriger ou contribuer à des projets stratégiques intersectoriels qui répondent à des besoins opérationnels en évolution.
 Exécute des travaux pratiques dans de multiples disciplines, y compris des efforts stratégiques qui nécessitent la coordination, l'analyse et la gestion des intervenants.
 Dirige des initiatives qui améliorent l'efficacité organisationnelle, l'expérience des employés et la satisfaction de la clientèle.

• Transformation de l'IA
 Indique les possibilités d'améliorer la productivité et l'efficacité de l'équipe grâce à l'automatisation, aux solutions compatibles avec l'IA et à l'innovation des processus.

Compétences
 Obligatoire/Qualification minimale

• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, gestion, informatique et expérience en gestion des affaires dans les environnements de vente et de terrain et de travail sur le rythme des affaires, y compris les opérations commerciales, la gestion des affaires, les finances ou d'autres environnements similaires

• OU expérience équivalente

• Expérience dans l'orchestration des stratégies d'engagement des commanditaires exécutifs, y compris la préparation d'exposés, l'alignement des intervenants et la responsabilisation de suivi pour accroître l'impact client.

• Suivre les résultats des principaux programmes interfonctionnels et des projets spéciaux qui stimulent la transformation des activités, la satisfaction de la clientèle et l'optimisation des processus internes.
 Qualifications préférées :

• L'allemand (écrit et verbal) est fortement préféré, pour dialoguer efficacement avec les parties prenantes régionales et soutenir la communication à travers les marchés germanophones. Le français et l'italien constitueraient un atout supplémentaire.

jobs.description:
Overview
 The Enterprise Partner Solutions (EPS) team is a sales organization accountable for driving partners’ commercial business with Microsoft enterprise customers. Its mission is to build and sell Microsoft Cloud, AI, and agentic applications and services with partners, empowering people and organizations to achieve more.

The Enterprise Partner Solutions (EPS) team is looking for a Segment Leader in Switzerland . As a key member of the Swiss Leadership Team , you are accountable for accelerating business growth and sales through the partner ecosystem and ISVs building pipeline, increasing partner-led consumption, and driving revenue across Intelligent Cloud, Agentic and Cyber Security. You will shape the country partner strategy and lead executive engagement with partners to capture a multi-million dollars market opportunity. Working in EPS means you are shaping the world’s largest ecosystem of technology companies.

Through our partners, Microsoft brings Cloud and AI ambitions to life by helping companies enrich employee experience, reinvent customer engagement, reshape business processes and bend the curve on innovation. The EPS Segment Leader plays a critical role in growing the world’s largest technology Partner ecosystem based on Microsoft’s Azure platform, Copilot and extended to unique applications through AI business solutions, Cloud and AI platform and Security.

The EPS Segment Leader owns the partner growth strategy for the segment and is accountable for delivering measurable revenue impact through ISVs, Global System Integrators, and Enterprise Services partners. This role builds and executes the strategic partner plan, mobilizes cross ‑ Microsoft teams, and drives joint solution development, scalable go ‑ to ‑ market programs, and disciplined co ‑ sell execution. Success is measured by partner ‑ led pipeline, closed revenue, and the expansion of Microsoft’s differentiated ecosystem in the market.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Organizational Leader - You will instill a culture of excellence in all business relationships and communications and deliver high performance and engagements with high integrity and respect for diverse experiences and capabilities. You will own the Executive Sponsorship program with partners and the local segment team, and the awards programs like the Partner of the Year Award.

• Area Partner Sales Leader - Develops the Area Partner Plan based on Partner AI Transformation strategies and relationships with Sales leaders to accelerate the partner Co-Sell motion driving clear Segment seller accountability, with partner alignment in Account and Territory Planning and partner engagements across the AI Innovations and AI labs. You will own the execution and success of the Enterprise Partner Connect for pipeline building.

• Strategic Partner – You will strategically partner with CEOs and be the executive sponsor of key business opportunities, practice building trends, and partner profitability - championing ways to innovate and expand the value of engagements. You will be the public voice for partners on GenAI, trusted cloud, secure future initiative and Microsoft AI cloud partner program.

• Business Owner – You will lead a culture of accountability on core priorities within EPS and across Microsoft, to exceed targets; leveraging business management and reporting rhythms for ongoing feedback and coaching through challenges.

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Management, or related field with extensive enterprise sales leadership experience. Proven track record of leading high ‑ performing, quota ‑ carrying sales and technical sales organizations, coaching teams on complex solution selling, account strategy, and pipeline development, and consistently exceeding revenue targets. Demonstrated ability to drive large, multi ‑ stakeholder sales cycles through partner ecosystems and centralized marketing engines.

• OR equivalent experience.

• Experienced in global and area ‑ level business leadership, directing Sales, Customer, and Partner teams to grow technology solution practices and deliver market impact across cloud, AI, infrastructure platforms, and subscription-based services.

• Deep understanding of partner-led sales models and differentiated partner business strategies in the enterprise market, including how digital transformation priorities—such as AI, agentic architectures, and cloud platforms—translate into partner solutions, scalable go ‑ to ‑ market motions, and revenue growth across the ecosystem.

• Proven track record of building deep business relationships with C-suite and practice building executives of ISV, GSI & Enterprise Services Partners

• Solid track record as an innovative business leader who has driven major strategic change initiatives and has executive gravitas, presence and credibility, including communication and presentation skills with a high degree of comfort to large and small technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Fluency in German

Find additional benefits and pay information here:
 https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/switzerland-corporate-pay.html

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer.  As a Microsoft Logistics Technician, you will perform cycle audits, e xecute incoming/outgoing deliveries, coordinate security escorts for third-party vendors , and document inbound and outbound deliveries as instructed by management. You will initiate warranty claims and process returns on failed equipment. This opportunity will allow you to build working knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction, and advance your career in the process.

As a CO+I Logistics Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Perform assigned tasks and escalate issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues.

• Coordinate with suppliers to initiate warranty claim and process failed vendor hardware devices. This includes information processing, packaging, shipment, and receipt of return for Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) devices following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) related to RMA warranty process.

• Develop working knowledge of stock control and inventory management practices and procedures.

• Ensure accurate documentation of incoming and outgoing deliveries as well as records.

• Become familiar with guidelines set by Microsoft contractual agreements with suppliers and maintain a strong customer focus.

• Perform cycle audits and data corrections to ensure all inventory controls are met.

• Help to reconcile and report inventory discrepancies.

• Ensure detailed physical inventory tracking and staging.

• Under the supervision of more experienced Data Center colleagues, destruction of data bearing devices (DBD) following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Microsoft policies.

• Comply with all security and data management policies.

• Embody our culture and values .

 Required Qualifications

• High School Diploma AND 6 months experience or an internship in inventory management, retail, warehouse management, or a related field

Treten Sie Microsofts Manufacturing Industry ATU bei, um einigen der weltweit führenden Hersteller dabei zu helfen, ihre KI- und digitalen Transformationsprozesse zu beschleunigen. Als Account Technology Strategist (ATS) sind Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für CIOs, CTOs, CDOs und Führungskräfte tätig und richten Technologieinvestitionen an strategischen Geschäftsergebnissen aus. Sie bringen fundiertes Know-how in der Fertigungsindustrie und ein Verständnis für Herausforderungen und Chancen in den Bereichen Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Smart Factory und Workforce Transformation mit. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Account Executives, Lösungsspezialisten, Partnern und Engineering-Teams leiten Sie Führungskräfte und erstellen branchenspezifische Innovations-Roadmaps. Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft der Fertigung zu beeinflussen und gleichzeitig das Geschäftswachstum voranzutreiben und messbare Auswirkungen auf die Kunden zu erzielen.
Microsofts Mission ist es, jede Person und jedes Unternehmen auf dem Planeten zu befähigen, mehr zu erreichen. Als Mitarbeiter kommen wir mit einer Wachstumsmentalität zusammen, innovieren, um andere zu stärken, und arbeiten zusammen, um unsere gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen. Jeden Tag bauen wir auf unseren Werten Respekt, Integrität und Rechenschaftspflicht auf, um eine Kultur der Inklusion zu schaffen, in der jeder bei der Arbeit und darüber hinaus gedeihen kann.

Zuständigkeiten

• Sie werden strategische Technologie-Engagements mit einigen der größten Fertigungskunden leiten und ihnen helfen, ihre KI- und digitale Transformationsvision zu definieren und umzusetzen.

• Sie bauen vertrauenswürdige Beraterbeziehungen zu CIOs, CTOs, CDOs und Führungskräften auf und übersetzen Geschäftsprioritäten in Technologie-Roadmaps und messbare Geschäftsergebnisse.

• Sie werden Führungskräftegespräche über AI, Data & Analytics, Security, Business Applications, Modern Work und Azure führen und zeigen, wie das End-to-End-Portfolio von Microsoft Innovationen und Wachstum beschleunigen kann.

• Durch die Nutzung von fundiertem Know-how in der Fertigungsindustrie identifizieren Sie Chancen in den Bereichen Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Smart Factory und Nachhaltigkeitsinitiativen und richten Technologieinvestitionen auf branchenspezifische Herausforderungen und Chancen aus.

• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Account Executives, Solution Specialists, Partnern und Engineering-Teams orchestrieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams, um transformative Kundenergebnisse und Geschäftswachstum zu erzielen.

• Sie werden als Vordenker im verarbeitenden Gewerbe auftreten und Kunden dabei helfen, neue Technologien zu übernehmen, die KI-Transformation zu beschleunigen und den vollen Wert ihrer digitalen Investitionen zu realisieren.

jobs.description:
Overview
 As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Responsibilities

• Contributes to issue tracking through escalations, asking questions, and seeking guidance on timely resolution of issues from more experienced technicians.

• Participates in daily safety briefings, completes required training aligned to the role and workload including safety training, complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).

• Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with guidance from other technicians.

• Complies with security and data management procedures and policies with guidance from other technicians and completes the required security training.

• Maintains a strong client focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned tasks.

• Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.

• Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and ownership of the data center facilities.

• Embodies our culture and values .

Qualifications
 Required Qualifications

Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.
 Background Check Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

• Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
 While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications :

• Some experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.

• Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

• A driving licence would be beneficial

In qualità di Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), svilupperai una comprensione dei processi e delle procedure standard per la preparazione, l'installazione, l'esecuzione di diagnostica, la risoluzione dei problemi, la sostituzione e/o la rimozione di apparecchiature sotto la guida di colleghi Data Center più esperti. Questa opportunità vi permetterà di sviluppare una comprensione del nostro ambiente Data Center, familiarizzare con le procedure di sicurezza e gestione dei dati e accelerare la crescita della vostra carriera nel processo.
Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) è il motore che alimenta i nostri servizi cloud. Come CO+I DCT, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella fornitura dell'infrastruttura e delle tecnologie fondamentali per i servizi online di Microsoft, tra cui Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive e la piattaforma Microsoft Azure. Come gruppo, CO+I si concentra sullo sviluppo personale e professionale di tutti i dipendenti e offre opportunità di formazione e crescita, tra cui Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion Trainings ed eventi, e certificazioni professionali.
La nostra infrastruttura è composta da un ampio portafoglio globale di oltre 200 Data Center in 32 paesi e milioni di server. La nostra fondazione è costruita e gestita da un team di esperti di materia che lavorano per supportare i servizi per oltre 1 miliardo di clienti e 20 milioni di imprese in oltre 90 paesi in tutto il mondo.
Con la sostenibilità ambientale e l'ottimizzazione all'avanguardia del nostro data center, continuiamo a crescere ed evolvere, soddisfando le esigenze aziendali in continua evoluzione che tengono Microsoft come provider cloud di livello mondiale.

responsabilità

• Contribuisce a emettere il monitoraggio attraverso escalation, fare domande, e alla ricerca di una guida sulla risoluzione tempestiva di problemi da tecnici più esperti.

• Partecipa ai briefing di sicurezza giornalieri, completa la formazione richiesta allineata al ruolo e al carico di lavoro, compresa la formazione di sicurezza, conforme alle procedure di sicurezza (ad esempio, uso di attrezzature, sollevamento, rischi elettrici, utilizzo scale/rolling).

• Completa i biglietti assegnati in modo efficiente e in allineamento con gli Indicatori di Prestazioni Chiave (KPI) durante l'incontro stabilito di livello di servizio Accordi (SLA) con la guida di altri tecnici.

• Conforme alle procedure e alle politiche di sicurezza e gestione dei dati con la guida di altri tecnici e completa la formazione di sicurezza richiesta.

• Mantiene un forte focus del cliente per capire l'impatto del loro lavoro durante il completamento dei biglietti e delle attività assegnate.

• Contribuisce a un ambiente di team positivo ed efficace condividendo le informazioni con gli altri, contribuendo a riunioni di team regolari, facendo domande, e rimanendo informato dello stato del lavoro degli altri.

• Ha orgoglio e un senso di responsabilità per la qualità del servizio, la completezza e la proprietà delle strutture data center.

• incarna la nostra cultura e i nostri valori.

Qualificazioni richieste

Completato High/Secondary School, GED, un apprendistato / qualifica professionale, o esperienza equivalente e conoscenza di base di hardware e componenti del computer.
Requisiti di controllo: Capacità di soddisfare i requisiti di screening di sicurezza Microsoft, cliente e/o governo sono necessari per questo ruolo. Questi requisiti includono, ma non sono limitati alle seguenti proiezioni di sicurezza specializzate:

Anche se non è necessario, cerchiamo anche le seguenti qualificazioni:

• Alcune esperienze che supportano l'attrezzatura IT o la relativa tecnologia.

• Certificazioni applicabili: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

• Una patente di guida sarebbe utile

Als Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) entwickeln Sie ein Verständnis für Standardprozesse und -verfahren zur Vorbereitung, Installation, Diagnose, Fehlerbehebung, Austausch und / oder Stilllegung von Geräten unter der Leitung erfahrenerer Data Center-Kollegen.
